gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-nandinagari: Commanding in its tall lowercase and unbroken strokes, Oxanium takes the heading while Noto Sans Nandinagari, a plain sans, sits beneath it with short ascenders. Bump the body size up a touch and its generous openings have room to show.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Tubing-smooth and a bit futuristic. Oxanium keeps its curves at full weight through every turn, while Noto Sans Nushu sets towering lowercase beneath it; a slightly smaller body size suggests itself.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Oxanium draws its heading like glowing neon tubing, each stroke the same gauge from start to finish, with a tall lowercase that looks big. Noto Sans Ogham follows quietly in tall, bold-looking sans letters.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Noto Sans Ol Chiki sets its curve tails well back from the body, so words land as solid blocks rather than jagged skylines. And Oxanium above it holds diagonals as thick as its horizontals, giving the pair a built, engineered feel.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-old-hungaria: Oxanium draws every heading stroke with no thick-thin swing at all, a high-lowercase display face with real presence. Noto Sans Old Hungarian is the counterweight, a plain sans whose large open counters stay legible even tiny.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Distinctive from the first glance, Oxanium looks traced with a marker, each curve ending in clear daylight. Noto Sans Old Italic answers by keeping x-height and cap height close together, which gives the sans-serif body a compact, businesslike look.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-old-north-ar: Tube-lit and sharp-edged. Oxanium glows like neon glass in the heading, while Noto Sans Old North Arabian packs a dense, tall lowercase band beneath, its terminals pointing outward like tongs.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-old-permic: Noto Sans Old Permic opens the pair with rounded forms that stay clearly open to the side, its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals. Oxanium above it is bent tubing in the same gauge throughout, and Noto Sans Old Permic carries a long page without tiring.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-old-persian: Clean and contemporary, Oxanium holds every heading line as tubelike and constant. Noto Sans Old Persian, a plain sans with lofty lowercase and counters that breathe, would read smoothly over a long passage.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdian: Oxanium looks drawn with a single nib, its tall lowercase and open curves giving the heading a confident, technical edge. Noto Sans Old Sogdian matches that height, keeping wide-mouthed letters crisp.
